lastEpisodeToAir.name: The Reunion
lastEpisodeToAir.overview: The agents from The Oppenheim Group gather together along with special guests in a tell-all reunion setting. They reflect on the season’s most intense drama, resolve lingering conflicts, and revisit major storylines.

overview: The elite agents at The Oppenheim Group sell the luxe life to affluent buyers in LA. Relationships are everything, and that often means major drama.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: Selling Sunset Season 1 (2019) introduces the high-stakes world of The Oppenheim Group in Los Angeles, where elite female brokers sell luxury real estate while navigating intense personal drama. New agent Chrishell Stause joins the team, immediately facing tension from veterans Christine Quinn and Heather Rae El Moussa, setting the stage for the show's signature cutthroat office politics.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: Luxe properties. Fabulous views. Enormous stakes. The agents of The Oppenheim Group mix business and pleasure — with maximum drama.

seasons.name: Season 3
seasons.overview: Big changes come to The Oppenheim Group as a major sale closes, the women consider career moves, and one agent faces a very public breakup.

seasons.name: Season 4
seasons.overview: The booming real estate market keeps the agents on their toes while new and returning teammates stir up the drama, and celebrity clients come calling.

seasons.name: Season 5
seasons.overview: New loves. Old foes. A fresh face. With the luxury market on fire, competition comes to a boil at the brokerage. Who'll shine — and who'll stumble?

seasons.name: Season 6
seasons.overview: The stakes and stilettos are as high as they've ever been at the brokerage, as longtime agents make big changes and two new team members bring the heat.

seasons.name: Season 7
seasons.overview: The agents hustle to move houses in a tough market, but bad blood and unfinished business could bring down what they've built. Can they keep it together?

seasons.name: Season 8
seasons.overview: Glam looks. Fierce clashes. Stunning homes. It's business as usual for The Oppenheim Group as they welcome a new agent and bid farewell to a dear friend.

seasons.name: Season 9
seasons.overview:
The sun is rising on massive deals and intense drama for The Oppenheim Group agents. Selling Sunset is back for Season 9, and with new episodes come new faces.

This season, the pressure is at an all-time high, and some agents might not have what it takes to keep their seats at the brokerage. “Season 9 definitely brings some unexpected twists,” new agent Sandra Vergara tells Tudum. “There are some jaw-dropping moments you won’t see coming.”
